validation.lineItemsRequired: At least one line item is required

success.whatsappShared: WhatsApp opened with the payment and PDF links

review.helperText: These values fill your invoice template. Edit anything before creating — the preview updates live.

emailNotice: Invoice email will be sent to the learner automatically after payment.

errors.previewFailed: Could not render the invoice preview. Please try again.

productLink.heading: Product (optional)
productLink.noMemberships: This learner has no membership to renew
productLink.accessUntilHint: Empty: extended by the plan’s validity from its current end date (or from the payment day if it has lapsed).
productLink.noInvite: No invite is set up for this yet: the learner gets free access through a new default invite.
productLink.notifyLearner: Send the enrolment email when it is paid
productLink.applyAsMemberPrice: Charge {{amount}} on future renewals too (instead of the plan price)
productLink.renewalNote: The membership is renewed when this invoice is paid. The invoice amount is the price of this renewal, and the payment is recorded on the membership.
productLink.enrollmentNote: The learner is enrolled when this invoice is paid. The invoice amount is the price, and the payment is recorded on the new membership.

errors.chooseMembership: Choose the membership this invoice renews
errors.chooseCourse: Choose what this invoice enrols the learner in
errors.orgAssociated: This one enrols learners into an organisation. Use Enrol Learner for it instead.
errors.cpo: This is paid in installments (fee plan). Use Enrol Learner; its installments are billed there.

productLink.applyNowRenewal: Renew now, collect the payment later
productLink.applyNowEnrol: Enrol now, collect the payment later
productLink.applyNowNote: Applied as soon as the invoice is created. The payment is recorded on the membership when it arrives. Cancelling the invoice later does not undo it.
productLink.applyAsMemberPriceHint: The membership moves to a plan at this price with the same validity. If no plan has this price, a private one is created that only this learner is on; the original plan does not change.
